content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271, the cardiac event monitoring study ordered for this patient. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9). As stated in the indication, the study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events and to guide anticoagulation management. These documented findings support the medical necessity of CPT 93271 for this episode, and we request reconsideration of the CO-97 denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 349.19."}
